speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The Port Authority has raised concerns about the impact of the wind park on Arcadia's maritime economy.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: The wind park restricts some of the routes traditionally used by vessels entering and leaving the port.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: Longer and more complicated shipping routes could increase costs for shipping companies.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: If these costs become too high, Arcadia risks losing business to competing ports.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: One possibility would be to relocate the port to another suitable area where it would be less affected by the wind park.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Relocating the port could protect its long-term competitiveness, but constructing new port infrastructure would be extremely costly.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: Keeping the existing port would avoid those construction costs, but we would have to accept the restrictions created by the wind park.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: How should Arcadia respond to the impact on the port?

options.label: Keep the port in its current location
Relocate the port to another suitable area
